name: speckit-xref
description: Keeps a GitHub Spec Kit feature and its code tied together inside Claude Code: the spec in the system prompt, every edit booked against a task, and a drift check after each turn.

mode.title: Drift mode
mode.description: advisory: the mod tells the model and the person about drift. strict: it also refuses edits outside the current task's planned or linked files.

driftCheck.title: Intent check after each turn
driftCheck.description: fork: after a turn that changed files, one tool-less question over the session asks whether the change still matches the user's words and the spec. off: deterministic checks only.

mapModel.title: Model for mapping and transcript-less checks
mapModel.description: The model that maps requirements to tasks (/xref map) and runs a drift check when there is no transcript to fork yet (an alias such as haiku, or a model id).
